title: Labor Rate on a Repeat Repair Estimate Written Away from the Home Store — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Rate lock.** On a Service Accounts and Repair Orders repeat repair estimate, the labor rate follows where the two repairs were written, the estimate's repair order being written at the store on the diagnostic fee.

| Estimate's repair order written | Earlier repair written | Labor rate |
|---|---|---|
| Away from the account's home store | At the home store | the earlier repair's posted labor rate |
| Away from the home store | Also away from it | the lesser of the two posted rates |
| At the home store | Anywhere | the posted labor rate on the diagnostic fee; no change applies |

**Terms.** The account's home store is the store where it was opened. The earlier repair is the repair order and concern line of the latest customer-pay parts charge on the vehicle; it was written at the store on its latest customer-pay labor charge, and its posted labor rate is the rate on that charge.

**Cases (hypothetical rates).** Diagnostic fee at an away store posted at 146.00:
- earlier repair at the home store at 139.00 — 139.00;
- earlier repair at another away store at 152.00 — 146.00, the lesser;
- if the diagnostic fee had been charged at the home store — 146.00 whatever the earlier rate.
